notes.subject: למו
notes.rationale: Poetic particle read as 'to them' (KJV/ASV, referring back to the people) or as emphatic 'to him' (YLT); taken here as 'bilong ol'.

notes.subject: Masiak
notes.rationale: משיחו rendered per glossary as 'man ol i kapsaitim oil long em' — anointed king, no later 'Krais' sense imported.

translation: Yahwe em i strong bilong ol, na em i strongpela banis bilong ol help we i seivim, bilong man ol i kapsaitim oil long em bilong en — em yet.
